Name: Bulk Buy Assistant
Author: tiennm0510
Description:
Bulk Buy Assistant adds a quantity popup for Stardew Valley shops.
Usage:
[list]
[*]Open any shop.[/*]
[*]Hold `F2` and click the item you want to buy.[/*]
[*]The popup title shows the item name and the maximum quantity you can buy.[/*]
[*]Enter the quantity and confirm.[/*]
[*]Hold `F3` and click the item to enter a currency budget instead. The mod buys as many as possible within that budget. For example, if an item costs 30g and you enter 100g, it buys 3 and spends 90g.[/*]
[/list]Compatibility: This mod uses Harmony to patch ShopMenu.tryToPurchaseItem. It should work with most shop stock/content mods, but may conflict with mods that alter shop purchase behavior or shop UI click handling.
